obligation: G21 census + G22 execution decomposition of the external MLX 2-bit abliterated artifact (S034 §2-3).

census.quant: EVERY language-model organ (embed, attention, deltanet, mlp, lm_head) = affine 2-bit group_size=32 = exactly 3.000 bpw effective (2 mantissa + fp16 scale + fp16 bias per 32 = 2 + 32/32).
census.unquantized: norms fp16 (1.3MB); the 921MB 'other' is the VISION_TOWER (multimodal VLM) kept in bf16 -- NOT touched during text decode; linear_attn conv1d kept bf16 (3.9MB).

REFRAME_decisive: The external '2-bit' is 3.22 bpw effective -- the SAME density class as our Hawking q3 (3.3448). It is NOT a representation-density win. The bits=2 label hides fp16 scale+bias (S034 EFFECTIVE-BPW gate: exactly the trap the gate exists for).

decomposition_37.7_vs_30_TPS.representation_share: ~1.16x of the 1.26x = fewer active bytes (10.09 vs 11.7 GB)
decomposition_37.7_vs_30_TPS.runtime_kernel_share: ~1.09x residual = mlx_lm affine2 GEMV vs our geo_tpr64
decomposition_37.7_vs_30_TPS.WHY_fewer_bytes: The external artifact quantizes ATTENTION to 3.0-bit affine and stays coherent (5/6). Our q3 patient over-provisions attention at ~4.25 bpw (thought it needed it). That attention gap is most of the 1.16x byte advantage.

gravity_compiler_rules_learned: affine grouped quant (scale + BIAS per group), g32, tolerates 2-bit-mantissa (3.0 eff bpw) on attention + deltanet + mlp + embed + lm_head while staying coherent -- our q3 need not keep attention at 4.25 bpw.
the 'bits' label is not the density; ALWAYS compute scale+bias+metadata overhead (g32 fp16 scale+bias = +1.0 bpw). EFFECTIVE-BPW gate.
vision tower is dead weight for text decode -- exclude from active-byte accounting.
native_reproduction_path: To reproduce ~38 TPS natively (G26) without the foreign runtime: (1) affine-2bit-g32 pack of the bf16 (representation, incl. 3.0-bit attention) -> ~10GB active; (2) native Metal affine2 GEMV kernel (in-register dequant of 2-bit mantissa + fp16 scale/bias) matching mlx_lm efficiency; (3) run through our Rust decoder. This gives a CLEAN same-runtime comparison and, per G31, room to go below the generic external quant (per-organ group size, cheaper/shared scale, mixed bits).
